title: Haye baysheer asghar
body:
raat bhar door se awaaz e buka aati hai
haye baysheer asghar
koi lori hai jo nauhe mein badal jati hai
haye baysheer asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
dil sambhaale hue dil thaame hue matamiyon
haan isay sunte raho
ek awaaz hai jo qalb ko thar'rati hai
haye baysheer asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi haathon pe shahe deen ke to chehre pe kabhi
ye nami hai kaisi
ye kisi khoon ki surhki si nazar aati hai
haye baysheer asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaali gehware ko aakhir ye hilaata hai kaun
aur behlaata hai kaun
bekasi jis ki taraf dekh ke sharmati hai
haye baysheer asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
umr bhar saaye mein baithi na tere baad kabhi
aur na baithegi kabhi
dhoop us maa ke kareeb aake thitak jaati hai
haye baysheer asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi dukhiayi behan door bahot door kahin
hai musalsal ghamgeen
yaad teri usay har waqt hi rulwati hai
haye baysheer asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
raat ka pichla pehar hogaya shahid phir bhi
hai wohi bechaini
ek faryaad ki ley arsh se takrati hai
haye baysheer asghar...
author: Shahid Jafer
